result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps, providing basic infrastructure for residents of the adjacent multi-unit housing. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming or pedestrian refuge islands increase exposure risk for those crossing.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line to the left of the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and signal control within a residential neighborhood. However, visibility is hindered by vehicles parked close to the crossing, and the lack of curb extensions increases the unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection limit the visibility of pedestrians to oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility.

result.summary: The environment features a marked zebra crosswalk at a mixed-use intersection with residential housing and a corner store. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the lack of active traffic control and sightline obstructions from parked vehicles at the corner create potential risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: A dark SUV is parked very close to the intersection corner, which can block the line of sight between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection, in front of the corner store.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled marked crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks stop signs or signals to regulate vehicle flow, relying entirely on driver compliance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to narrow the roadway at the crossing, reducing pedestrian exposure and slowing turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility 'Pedestrian Crossing' signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

result.summary: The image shows a mixed-use urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks and sidewalks. While a traffic signal is present, the environment lacks advanced safety features like curb extensions or dedicated pedestrian signals, and the corner building placement may limit sightlines.

hazards.name: Limited Sightlines
hazards.description: The commercial building on the corner is situated close to the roadway, potentially obstructing the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and drivers approaching from the side street.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signalization
hazards.description: While a traffic light is visible for vehicles, no dedicated pedestrian signal heads are clearly visible to provide safe crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.
